{{Quote|Subject identified as Duchess Satine Kryze.|A police probe|<ref name="TCWDofM" />}}
A [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] '''[[Police probe/Legends|police probe]]''' was flying patrol in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Sector GL5/Legends|Sector GL5]] when a shot rang out and the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] spotted [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] beside the body of [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] of the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]]. The [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] probe assumed the Duchess had killed Golect and issued an alert to other CSF and [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] units. Several [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]] and [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|Riot clone troopers]] took up the chase. However, the Duchess shot the probe, disabling it and causing it to fall and trip up the pursuing police and [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="TCWDofM" />
